hl.title: Strengths and challenges
hl.lede: Every point below comes from a classical rule applied to this chart: dignities, yogas, doshas, the Lagna lord and Ashtakavarga bindus.

charts.title: Kundali charts
charts.lede: Birth chart, Navamsa and Moon chart. Graha colours match the cards below; a red R marks a retrograde graha.
charts.d1t: The main birth chart. Houses are counted from {r} Lagna.
charts.d9t: Each sign split into nine parts of 3°20′. Read for marriage and inner strength.
charts.moont: Houses counted from the Moon in {r}.

belt.title: The zodiac at birth
belt.lede: The full 360° laid flat: 12 rashis of 30°, 27 nakshatras of 13°20′ (numbered), and each graha at its exact sidereal degree.

grahas.title: The nine grahas
grahas.lede: Position, dignity and an indicative strength score for each graha. The score combines dignity, house, combustion, retrogression and Ashtakavarga bindus; it is a guide, not Shadbala.

yogas.title: Yogas and doshas
yogas.lede: {g} beneficial yogas and {b} doshas found. Each card shows the rule that was checked.

dasha.title: Vimshottari Dasha
dasha.lede: The 120-year cycle starts from the lord of the Moon's nakshatra. The Moon had covered {p}% of {nk} at birth, leaving {v} of {g} dasha.
dasha.nowText: The {md} period runs from {s} to {e}. The current {ad} sub-period ends on {ae}.
dasha.tone_good: {g} is strong in this chart, which supports this period.
dasha.tone_bad: {g} is weak in this chart, so this period asks for patience.
dasha.tone_mixed: {g} is of moderate strength in this chart.

pan.title: Panchang at birth
pan.lede: The five limbs of the Hindu calendar at the moment of birth. The Moon drawing shows its real phase.
pan.localTime: local time at the birth place

bhava.title: The twelve bhavas
bhava.lede: Whole-sign houses from the Lagna. The SAV bar shows Sarvashtakavarga bindus: 28 or more is strong, below 25 is weak.
bhava.name: {n} Bhava

ashtaka.title: Ashtakavarga
ashtaka.lede: Benefic points each graha receives in every sign from eight reference points. The Sarva total always adds up to 337.

gochar.title: Transits today
gochar.lede: Where the grahas are on {d}, counted from your Moon sign. Favourable houses follow the classical gochar rules for each graha.

method.title: How it is calculated
method.p1: The Sun and planets come from Keplerian orbital elements with the main Jupiter–Saturn perturbations. The Moon uses the 60-term lunar series from Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms. Rahu is the mean lunar node. Positions are converted to sidereal with the Lahiri ayanamsa, and the Lagna is solved from local sidereal time and latitude.
method.p2: Checked against the Swiss Ephemeris on 3,000 dates from 1900 to 2100: Moon within about 1′, Lagna within 1′, other grahas within 3½′. Houses are whole-sign. Yogas and doshas follow the rules shown on each card; traditions differ on cancellations.

dig.own: It sits in its own sign, comfortable and dependable.
dig.friendly: It is in a friendly sign and well supported.
dig.neutral: It is in a neutral sign.

read.retro: It is retrograde, which adds intensity and turns its energy inward.

gajakesari.name: Gajakesari Yoga
gajakesari.rule: Guru in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the Moon
gajakesari.text: Guru is in house {h} from the Moon. Gives wisdom, reputation and lasting prosperity.
gajakesari.off: Guru is in house {h} from the Moon, not a kendra.

budhaditya.name: Budhaditya Yoga
budhaditya.rule: Surya and Budh in the same sign
budhaditya.text: Sharp intellect, good communication and recognition for skill.

chandramangal.name: Chandra-Mangal Yoga
chandramangal.rule: Chandra and Mangal in the same sign
chandramangal.text: Drive for earning and a talent for business and wealth.

ruchaka.name: Ruchaka Yoga
ruchaka.rule: {g} in its own or exalted sign in a kendra from Lagna
ruchaka.text: One of the five Pancha Mahapurusha yogas: courage, leadership and physical strength.

bhadra.name: Bhadra Yoga
bhadra.rule: {g} in its own or exalted sign in a kendra from Lagna
bhadra.text: One of the five Pancha Mahapurusha yogas: intelligence, eloquence and business skill.

hamsa.name: Hamsa Yoga
hamsa.rule: {g} in its own or exalted sign in a kendra from Lagna
hamsa.text: One of the five Pancha Mahapurusha yogas: wisdom, virtue and respect.

malavya.name: Malavya Yoga
malavya.rule: {g} in its own or exalted sign in a kendra from Lagna
malavya.text: One of the five Pancha Mahapurusha yogas: beauty, comfort, art and a happy marriage.

sasa.name: Sasa Yoga
sasa.rule: {g} in its own or exalted sign in a kendra from Lagna
sasa.text: One of the five Pancha Mahapurusha yogas: authority, discipline and lasting achievement.

raj.name: Raj Yoga
raj.rule: A kendra lord and a trikona lord together in one sign
raj.text: Formed by {list}. Brings rise in status and authority.
raj.off: No kendra lord and trikona lord are together.

yogakaraka.name: Yogakaraka
yogakaraka.rule: One graha rules both a kendra and a trikona
yogakaraka.text: {list} rules both a kendra and a trikona for this Lagna and acts as the chart's chief benefic.
yogakaraka.off: No single graha rules both a kendra and a trikona for this Lagna.

vipreet.name: Vipreet Raj Yoga
vipreet.rule: The lord of house 6, 8 or 12 placed in house 6, 8 or 12
vipreet.text: The {list} sits in a dusthana. Success can come out of difficult situations.
vipreet.off: No dusthana lord is placed in a dusthana.

adhi.name: Adhi Yoga
adhi.rule: Two or more natural benefics in houses 6, 7 or 8 from the Moon
adhi.text: Leadership, a comfortable life and victory over rivals.

durudhara.name: Durudhara Yoga
durudhara.rule: Grahas on both sides of the Moon (houses 2 and 12 from it)
durudhara.text: Wealth, comforts and a generous nature.

sunapha.name: Sunapha Yoga
sunapha.rule: A graha in house 2 from the Moon
sunapha.text: Self-earned wealth and a good reputation.

anapha.name: Anapha Yoga
anapha.rule: A graha in house 12 from the Moon
anapha.text: Good health, charm and a contented life.

kemadruma.name: Kemadruma Yoga
kemadruma.rule: No graha in houses 2 or 12 from the Moon, and none in a kendra from it
kemadruma.text: The Moon stands alone, which can bring loneliness or money worries.

grahan.name: Grahan Dosha
grahan.rule: Surya or Chandra in the same sign as Rahu or Ketu
grahan.text: {list} is joined by a node, which can cloud confidence or peace of mind.
grahan.off: Neither Surya nor Chandra is joined by Rahu or Ketu.

guruchandal.name: Guru Chandal Dosha
guruchandal.rule: Guru in the same sign as Rahu or Ketu
guruchandal.text: Guru is with {g}; judgement and advice from teachers may be clouded.
guruchandal.off: Guru is free of Rahu and Ketu.

shakata.name: Shakata Yoga
shakata.rule: Moon in house 6, 8 or 12 from Guru, and the Moon not in a kendra
shakata.text: Ups and downs in fortune, like the turning wheel of a cart.

mangal.name: Mangal Dosha
mangal.text: Present counted from {list}. Mangal is in house {a} from Lagna, {b} from the Moon and {c} from Shukra.
mangal.off: Mangal is in house {a} from Lagna, {b} from the Moon and {c} from Shukra.

kaalsarp.name: Kaal Sarp Dosha
kaalsarp.rule: All seven grahas on one side of the Rahu–Ketu axis
kaalsarp.off: The grahas are spread on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis.
kaalsarp.sarp: All grahas lie from Rahu to Ketu (Kaal Sarp)
kaalsarp.amrit: All grahas lie from Ketu to Rahu (Kaal Amrit)

gandmool.name: Gand Mool
gandmool.rule: Moon in Ashwini, Ashlesha, Magha, Jyeshtha, Mula or Revati
gandmool.text: The Moon is in {nk}. Traditionally a shanti puja is advised.
gandmool.off: The Moon is in {nk}, not a Gand Mool nakshatra.

static.featTitle: A complete Vedic birth chart, free
static.featLede: Kundali Ganit calculates your chart from first principles, then reads it with classical Jyotish rules.

features.p: Sidereal degrees of all nine grahas, checked against the Swiss Ephemeris.
In North Indian or South Indian style.
Raj yoga, Gajakesari, Mangal dosha, Kaal Sarp, Sade Sati and more, each with the rule shown.
Mahadasha and antardasha dates for 100 years, with the running period highlighted.
Tithi, vara, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise and sunset.
All twelve houses with lords, occupants and bindu strength.
Gochar from your Moon sign, marked favourable or unfavourable.
Every chart you make is saved to your account. Only you can see it.

p: A Janma Kundali (birth chart) is a map of the sky at the exact moment and place of your birth. It shows the Lagna (the sign rising in the east), the twelve bhavas (houses) and the positions of the nine grahas in the twelve rashis and twenty-seven nakshatras.
Jyotish reads this map to understand temperament, strengths and challenges, and uses the Vimshottari dasha system to time the main periods of life.

Your birth time is converted to Universal Time using the time zone history of your birth place. The positions of the Sun, Moon and planets are then computed from orbital mathematics and converted to the sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsa, the standard used by the Government of India's calendar.
The Lagna is solved from local sidereal time and your latitude. Yogas, doshas and strengths are then checked with stated classical rules, so you can see why each result appears.

static.faqLede: Answers to common questions about Kundali and how this site works.

faq.a: A Kundali, or Janma Kundali, is a Vedic birth chart: the positions of the Sun, Moon, planets, Rahu and Ketu at the moment of your birth, arranged in twelve houses from the Lagna (ascendant). It is the basis of all Jyotish readings.

faq.q: What details do I need to make my Kundali?
faq.a: Your date of birth, exact time of birth and place of birth. The place gives latitude, longitude and time zone, which are needed to calculate the Lagna and houses correctly.

faq.q: What if I don't know my exact birth time?
faq.a: Planet signs and most nakshatras will still be correct, because they change slowly. The Lagna changes about every two hours and the Lagna degree about every four minutes, so house positions and dasha dates depend on an accurate time.

Planet positions are calculated with astronomical formulas and were tested against the Swiss Ephemeris for 1900 to 2100. The Moon and Lagna agree within about one arc-minute, and the other planets within about three and a half arc-minutes.

faq.q: Which ayanamsa does Kundali Ganit use?
faq.a: It uses the Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa, the standard adopted by the Indian Calendar Reform Committee and used by most Indian astrologers and panchangs.

Mangal dosha is present when Mars sits in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house. Kundali Ganit checks it from the Lagna, the Moon and Venus. Many traditions also apply cancellation rules, so discuss important decisions with an astrologer.

Vimshottari is a 120-year cycle of planetary periods. Your starting period depends on the nakshatra of the Moon at birth. Each mahadasha is divided into nine antardashas, and Kundali Ganit lists the dates for 100 years.

faq.q: Why do I need to log in, and is my data private?
faq.a: Logging in is free. It lets you see the full Kundali and saves each chart to your account so you can open it later. Your charts are stored with row-level security, so only you can read them.

footer.text: Positions are computed from orbital mathematics with Lahiri ayanamsa. Readings follow classical rules and are a guide, not a certainty.
